title: Lamb Vindaloo
description: Succulent lamb cooked low and slow in a classic, fiery vindaloo sauce.

method.instruction: Prepare vindaloo paste according to the paste recipe and set aside.
Place lamb in a large bowl. Add vindaloo paste and toss to coat. Cover and marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour, or overnight for best flavour.
Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add onions and sauté 2–3 minutes until soft and translucent. Add garlic and sauté 1 minute until fragrant.
Add ground turmeric, red chilli powder, tomato paste, tomatoes, and cider vinegar. Cook 2–3 minutes until tomatoes break down and turn mushy.
Add lamb and sugar. Season with salt. Cook around 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in the water and stir.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium. Cover and simmer for about 1 hour or until lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves before serving.
